title: Her Majesty's Treasury - proposed acquisition of additional shares in Lloyds Banking Group

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: HMT proposed to acquire additional shares in Lloyds, taking its total interest from 43.4% to up to 77%.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered it unnecessary to define a relevant market.
body_sections.Competition analysis: As the activities of HMT and Lloyds did not overlap, the ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in any relevant Australian markets.
